description: Main FastAPI application for EC2 management, including endpoints for health checks, listing instances, manual and automated instance shutdown, logging, and AI/ML model training and recommendations.

methods.name: boto_session_dep(settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)])
methods.description: Dependency to provide a configured boto3 session based on settings.

methods.name: on_startup()
methods.description: Initialize database and start background scheduler on app startup.

methods.name: on_shutdown()
methods.description: Gracefully stop the background scheduler on app shutdown.

methods.name: list_running( settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)], session_boto=Depends(boto_session_dep), region: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="AWS region override"), )
methods.description: Lists all currently running EC2 instances, optionally filtered by region.

methods.name: trigger_idle_shutdown( settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)], session_boto=Depends(boto_session_dep), )
methods.description: Manually triggers shutdown of idle EC2 instances based on threshold.

methods.name: list_shutdown_logs(limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=1000))
methods.description: Retrieves recent EC2 shutdown event logs from the database.

methods.name: websocket_usage_note()
methods.description: Provides a note indicating no WebSocket endpoints are present.

methods.name: ai_train_usage_model( events: list[dict] = Body( default=..., description="Array of usage events: [{user_id, instance_id, start_time, end_time}]", ) )
methods.description: Trains an AI model based on provided usage event data.

methods.name: ai_get_recommendation( user_id: str = Query(..., description="User identifier"), instance_id: str = Query(..., description="Instance identifier"), threshold: float = Query(0.3, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="Threshold below which to recommend shutdown"), )
methods.description: Provides a weekly schedule for auto-shutdown recommendations.

ctags.name: ai_get_recommendation
ctags.signature: ( user_id: str = Query(..., description="User identifier"), instance_id: str = Query(..., description="Instance identifier"), threshold: float = Query(0.3, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="Threshold below which to recommend shutdown"), )

ctags.name: ai_train_usage_model
ctags.signature: ( events: list[dict] = Body( default=..., description="Array of usage events: [{user_id, instance_id, start_time, end_time}]", ) )

ctags.name: list_running
ctags.signature: ( settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)], session_boto=Depends(boto_session_dep), region: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="AWS region override"), )
